summary: EP03+EP04 mentor gold cut · 5 lens 并行挖掘 where/how 剪辑模式 · 输出 patterns.json
logs: 5 lens 完成: 5 有效结果

lenses.finding_summary: 在 59 条 gold cut（EP03 56 + EP04 3）中，mentor 的下刀点集中在词间 pause 的中段：主轨 gap_before 中位数 180ms（p25=120, p75=260），gap_after 中位数 280ms（p25=120, p75=440），呈尾长头短的轻度不对称。整体 46.6% (27/58) 命中 silence gap，且分类差异极大：boundary_review 65%、filler_hesitation 33%、pause 0%。pause 类因为把整段静音都切掉，边界贴在词尾/次词首（gb≈100, ga≈120）。boundary_offset_from_silence_edge_ms 有 14/27 顶到 300ms 上限，说明落入 silence gap 时倾向深植而非蹭边。极端紧贴案例（gb<50ms）仅 3/58 = 5%，且其中 2 条属 pause 分类；gb<100ms 也仅 7/58 = 12%，可视为硬红线。

patterns.pattern_desc: 主轨下刀点落在 pause 中段而非贴词：gap_before p25=120 / median=180 / p75=260 ms，gap_after p25=120 / median=280 / p75=440 ms。极端紧贴（gb<50ms）仅 3/58 = 5%，gb<100ms 仅 7/58 = 12%。
boundary_review 类 37 条中 24 条 (65%) 命中 silence gap；filler_hesitation 33% (2/6)；pause 0% (0/13)。mentor 在 boundary_review 场景强偏好把刀落在检测出的静音段内。
命中 silence gap 时，boundary_offset_from_silence_edge_ms 中位数 300 且 14/27 顶到 300ms 上限，p25=76ms；下刀点倾向深植静音中段而非蹭静音边缘。
28/58 尾长（ga>1.3×gb）vs 20/58 头长 vs 10/58 对称；median ga=280 显著大于 median gb=180。mentor 留给下一句略更宽的起呼吸窗，尤其在 boundary_review（gb 180 / ga 300）。
pause 分类 13 条全部 lands_in_silence=False，且 gb median=100 / ga median=120，说明 pause 场景刀口贴在词尾与次词首、把整段静音一次性移除，与 boundary_review 完全不同的 WHERE 策略。
filler_hesitation 6 条：gb median=210（头留呼吸避免撞上填充词前的字），ga median=110（尾贴紧下一词以免拖泥带水），呈显著 head-pad / tail-tight 结构。
59 条中 56 条采用 mentor_crossfade=50ms（默认）；仅 3 条 (EP04 GOLD_C007/C034/C044) 用 ~200ms，全部无 gold_category、疑似 3 轨多人场景的过渡处理。50ms 是稳定默认。

rule_proposals.note: 落在 mentor p25-p75 主区间；对 boundary_review 与 filler_hesitation 通用。
boundary_review 命中 silence gap 且 offset ≥ p25(=76ms) 时优先采用；符合 65% 命中率与深植偏好。
pause 场景：刀口贴词尾与次词首（gb≈100 / ga≈120 中位）、整段静音被切除；不要求落在 silence gap 内。
filler：头留 ~200ms 呼吸、尾紧贴 ~100ms；对称候选降权。
gap_before<50ms 且不在 silence gap 里的紧贴案例仅 2 例且均为 pause 分类；对 boundary_review/filler 建议直接拒绝。
尾长头短是 mentor 主流（28/58 尾长 vs 20/58 头长）；当两个候选打平，优先 ga≥gb 的那个。
默认 50ms 覆盖 95% 场景；仅 EP04 三轨过渡观察到 ~200ms（3 例，样本少）。

lenses.finding_summary: In EP04 (3 gold cuts, host=track_03, guest=track_01/02), 3/3 gold cuts land while host is silent (host covered_word_texts empty, host gap_before_cut_ms 1901-8710, gap_after 2604-48544). main_track is never host (0/3); it is guest track_02 in 2/3 and None in 1/3. cross_track_speaking is True in 2/3 EP04 cases but is driven by mic bleed between guest tracks 01 and 02 (both cover identical text '因为' or '就是我们*'), not by simultaneous host+guest speech. In EP03 (56 cuts, 2-track male/female), the same flag is 100% True and both tracks show 100% non-empty covered_words, confirming cross_track_speaking as currently defined is dominated by cross-mic bleed and cannot distinguish real overlap from spillover. Solo-guest EP04 samples span pause-like (C007, 385 ms, all tracks silent-in-window) and filler/self-correction (C034 '就是我们我们', C044 '因为').

patterns.pattern_desc: EP04 gold cuts occur only when host track_03 is silent through the cut window: covered_word_texts is empty in 3/3 records and gap_before/gap_after on host are >=1.9s/>=2.6s. Host is never the primary edit target.

cross_track_speaking=True is dominated by adjacent-mic bleed, not real simultaneous speech. EP03 shows 56/56 True with both male and female tracks always non-empty (2-track bleed). EP04 True cases (C034, C044) have track_01 and track_02 covering the same or near-identical text ('就是我们*', '因为'), i.e. two guest mics on one guest.

When host is silent, gold cuts fall into two subtypes: (a) pause / boundary_review (C007, 385 ms, all guest tracks silent in window) and (b) filler / self-correction on the guest (C034 duplication '就是我们我们', C044 filler '因为'). No host-domain cut appears in EP04 gold.

rule_proposals.note: 3/3 EP04 gold cuts satisfy this gate, but n=3 is too small to promote. Collect more EP04 gold before shipping as hard rule; safe as a soft prior (raise cut probability when host is silent, lower it when host has covered_words).

redefine_true_iff: covered_word_texts[track_a] and covered_word_texts[track_b] are both non-empty

rule_proposals.note: Current flag is 100% True on EP03 and misfires on EP04 guest-mic bleed, so it carries no signal. Adding a speaker_map check plus a same-text bleed filter would flip C034/C044 to False and unmask real host+guest overlaps.
0/3 EP04 gold cuts target the host. Consistent with the audit rule of protecting host continuity, but sample too small to prove host cuts are never gold; keep as soft veto pending more data.

candidate_pattern.if: host silent and main_track_id in {track_01, track_02}

rule_proposals.note: Aligns with existing memory rules (filler_boundary_lock, self_correction all-or-none). Confirms that once host-silent gate passes, the cut type is decided by the guest track's covered_word_texts, not by the cross-track flag.

lenses.finding_summary: mentor_crossfade_ms is not situationally modulated at all: EP03 is a flat 50ms across every one of its 56 cuts, EP04 is a flat ~200ms across all 3 cuts (2 exactly 200ms=9600@48kHz, 1 at 192.583ms=9244 samples — a 356-sample rounding artefact from a boundary-quantised cut, not a policy variation). Within EP03 the crossfade does not respond to duration, gold_category, silence_gap hit, or cross-track speaking. The choice looks like a per-episode/project constant, not a per-cut decision — so any recommender for crossfade must key on episode/production profile rather than local acoustic or duration features.

patterns.pattern_desc: mentor_crossfade_ms is a per-episode constant, not a per-cut computed value. EP03 = 50ms on 56/56 cuts (stdev 0). EP04 = 200ms on 2/3, 192.583ms on 1/3; the 192.583 case decodes to exactly 9244 samples at 48kHz — a boundary-snapping remainder off a 9600-sample target, i.e. still the same 200ms policy quantised to the cut window.

Within EP03 the crossfade does not shorten for short cuts or lengthen for long cuts. Mean xf is 50ms in every duration bucket: <500ms (n=8), 500–2000ms (n=23), 2000–5000ms (n=18), >=5000ms (n=7). EP04 shows the opposite tendency but only on 3 short cuts (all <700ms) at 200ms — insufficient to establish an inverse relationship; consistent with P1 (episode-level constant).
evidence_cuts: EP04 durations 385.2/680.0/425.7 ms all get ~200ms xf

patterns.pattern_desc: cut_lands_in_silence_gap does not shorten the crossfade. In EP03, 26 cuts land in a silence gap and 30 do not — both groups get 50ms exactly. The hypothesis 'silence hits get a shorter fade' is falsified by this dataset.
gold_category (boundary_review n=37, pause n=13, filler_hesitation n=6) has no effect on crossfade in EP03; all three categories are pinned to 50ms.

cross_track_speaking is true for 56/56 EP03 cuts, so its effect cannot be estimated from EP03 alone; however since xf is flat 50ms across that entire true-only sample, it cannot be a live modulator either — again consistent with the episode-constant hypothesis (P1).
evidence_cuts: no cross_track_speaking=false rows present in either file

patterns.pattern_desc: EP04 GOLD_C007 xf=192.583ms is not a policy deviation but a sample-quantised clamp: 9244 samples = 9600 - 356 at 48kHz, i.e. the fade was truncated by 356 samples (~7.4ms) at one edge, consistent with the 385.2ms cut being too short to host the full 200ms symmetric fade. Treat 192.583 as 200-target-clamped-by-window.

rule_proposals.note: Set crossfade as a per-episode/production constant read from a profile, not from local features. Two mentor-observed operating points so far: 50ms (EP03) and 200ms (EP04). Default new episodes to the last approved profile of the same show; require an explicit mentor override to move between 50ms and 200ms.

When cut_duration is shorter than 2 * target_xf, quantise-and-clamp exactly as mentor did on EP04 GOLD_C007 (200ms target -> 192.583ms actual, 9600 -> 9244 samples). Record this as a clamp event, not as a policy variation.

None of the local features move the crossfade in this dataset. Within EP03 (n=56) xf is 50ms regardless of duration bucket (<500 / 500-2000 / 2000-5000 / >=5000), regardless of silence-gap landing (True vs False), and regardless of category (boundary_review / pause / filler_hesitation). Do not build a feature-conditioned crossfade regressor on this data — it would fit noise.

needed: episodes where mentor_crossfade_ms varies within a single episode
at least one episode with cross_track_speaking=false cuts to test that axis
labelled reasons for 50ms vs 200ms production choice

rule_proposals.note: Confidence in the modulator-independence conclusion is dataset-limited: EP04 has only 3 cuts and they are all short and all in-silence-adjacent. Before locking in the episode-constant rule, gather at least one episode with intra-episode xf variance, otherwise we cannot distinguish 'per-episode constant' from 'per-project-so-far constant'.

lenses.finding_summary: In 58 gold cuts, boundary RMS matching is NOT enforced. Mean rms_before = -32.8 dB (median -31.1), mean rms_after = -35.3 dB (median -38.4), mean rms_middle = -28.6 dB (median -26.6). Middle segment is louder than the mean of the two edges in 43/58 (74%) and louder than BOTH edges (RMS "hump") in 29/58 (50%); a middle "valley" appears in only 7/58 (12%). The before-after gap is roughly symmetric around 0 (31 cases before>after by >1 dB, 24 after>before by >1 dB, 3 quasi-equal) with mean +2.4 dB and median +1.7 dB. Absolute mismatch |before-after| exceeds 10 dB in 28/58 (48%), exceeds 25 dB in 8/58 (14%), and reaches 33.9 dB at the extreme; only 17/58 (29%) sit within +/-3 dB. Mentor's chosen mentor_crossfade_ms stays at a 50 ms median across all three |diff| bins (<=3 dB, 3-10 dB, >10 dB), i.e. crossfade is not scaled to RMS mismatch. Whether the cut lands in a silence gap does not change |diff| (in-gap mean 12.7 dB vs not-in-gap 12.3 dB); it mainly shifts rms_middle down (-33 dB in-gap vs -24.8 dB not-in-gap). Conclusion: mentor treats boundary RMS mismatch as a tolerable acoustic byproduct, and treats middle-louder-than-edges as the normal signature of a speech-carrying deletion, not a defect.

patterns.pattern_desc: Mentor tolerates large boundary RMS mismatch: |rms_before - rms_after| exceeds 10 dB on 48% of gold cuts (28/58) and exceeds 25 dB on 14% (8/58), max 33.9 dB. Tight matches (|diff|<=3 dB) are the minority at 29%. There is no systematic direction (before louder in 31, after louder in 24).

The deleted middle is louder than the boundary environment: rms_middle > mean(before,after) in 74% (43/58) and louder than BOTH edges (hump) in 50% (29/58); middle-valley is rare (12%, 7/58). rms_middle - max(edges) > 10 dB is uncommon (5/58, 9%), so the hump is moderate, not extreme.
evidence_cuts: mean rms_middle -28.6 dB vs mean rms_before -32.8 dB and mean rms_after -35.3 dB
median rms_middle -26.6 dB vs median rms_after -38.4 dB
GOLD_C001 (b=-37.3, m=-25.3, a=-54.0) middle louder than both
GOLD_C020 (b=-55.8, m=-30 range, a=-24.6) hump case
only 7/58 valley cases where middle < both edges

patterns.pattern_desc: mentor_crossfade_ms does NOT scale with boundary RMS mismatch. Median crossfade is 50 ms in every |diff| bucket (<=3 dB, 3-10 dB, >10 dB); means are 58.8 / 50.0 / 55.4 ms. Mentor absorbs RMS jumps with a fixed short crossfade rather than lengthening the fade.
evidence_cuts: |diff|<=3 dB: n=17 median=50 ms mean=58.8 ms (max 200 ms)
|diff| 3-10 dB: n=13 median=50 ms mean=50.0 ms
|diff|>10 dB: n=28 median=50 ms mean=55.4 ms (max 200 ms)
GOLD_C015 |diff|=33.9 dB still uses 50 ms crossfade

patterns.pattern_desc: Boundary RMS pairs distribute across three regimes: silence-silence (both edges < -40 dB) 11/58 (19%), asymmetric silence (one edge <-40, other >-40) 22/58 (38%), speech-speech (both > -30 dB) 16/58 (28%). Asymmetric silence is the single largest regime — mentor cuts freely from a speaking edge into a silent edge (and vice versa).

cut_lands_in_silence_gap does not reduce boundary |diff| (in-gap mean 12.7 dB vs not-in-gap 12.3 dB) but it does lower rms_middle (in-gap mean -33.0 dB vs not-in-gap -24.8 dB). Landing in silence therefore mainly protects against MIDDLE energy showing up as a click, not against edge-to-edge RMS jumps.
evidence_cuts: in-gap n=27 mean|diff|=12.7 dB mean_middle=-33.0 dB
not-in-gap n=31 mean|diff|=12.3 dB mean_middle=-24.8 dB

candidate_pattern.action_hard: flag for review or extend crossfade beyond 50 ms

rule_proposals.note: 48% of gold cuts already exceed 10 dB mismatch and 14% exceed 25 dB; a soft gate at 15 dB and a hard gate at 25 dB matches the observed mentor tolerance without rejecting typical cuts.

candidate_pattern.action: do NOT treat middle_louder_than_edges as a defect signal

rule_proposals.note: rms_middle exceeds edge mean in 74% of gold cuts (hump in 50%). Middle-louder is the norm for a speech-carrying deletion; only flag when middle exceeds max(edges) by more than ~10 dB AND the cut does not land in a silence gap.

candidate_pattern.observed: constant median 50 ms across all |diff| buckets
candidate_pattern.action: keep crossfade at 50 ms default; do not auto-scale by boundary RMS diff

rule_proposals.note: Mentor did not lengthen crossfade even at |diff|=33.9 dB. Dynamic crossfade scaling by RMS mismatch is not supported by the data; if boundary artifacts remain, address them via cut-point relocation or gap alignment, not longer fades.

candidate_pattern.metric: boundary regime = classify(rms_before, rms_after) into {silence-silence, asymmetric-silence, speech-speech}
candidate_pattern.action: treat all three regimes as valid; do not require silence-silence

rule_proposals.note: Asymmetric-silence is the largest regime (38%). A cut policy that only permits silence-silence boundaries would reject the majority of mentor-approved cuts.

lenses.finding_summary: {"headline":"mentor 的 gold cut 高度偏向 semantic_boundary（71.2%），其次 immediate_rep（20.3%），self_correction（3.4%）与 long_pause（5.1%）；两集合并 59 条中 pure_filler=0、rhetorical_emphasis=0","reliability":"HIGH_ON_DIST_MID_ON_LABELS","reason":"分类基于 gold_deleted_text 的字符级重复/自纠正关键词/静默覆盖度启发式；semantic_boundary 是 Mentor 反推区间的兜底类，边界内部并未验证语义主题，故该类内部可能混入少量本可拆分的 immediate_rep/self_correction","key_flip":"短 cut(<400ms)命中率仅 10.2%，且全部为 immediate_rep 或 long_pause，无一为 pure_filler；长 cut(>800ms)命中率 72.9%，主体是 semantic_boundary。'剪 filler' 的直觉与数据相反——Mentor 剪的是重复与段落边界，而非孤立语气词","negative_evidence":"两集无任何 rhetorical_emphasis 或 pure_filler 命中，可作为反例保护规则","episode_split":"EP03 56 条覆盖 4 类；EP04 3 条全部落在 long_pause（空文本，纯静默）"}

patterns.pattern_desc: Mentor 的 gold cut 以 semantic_boundary 类为主体（42/59=71.2%，均值 2720ms，中位 2020ms），且 24/42（57%）落在静默间隙内——即 Mentor 更倾向在段落断点做长区间的语义级剪辑，而非砍孤立语气词
6 条 <400ms 短 cut 全部命中 immediate_rep（5）或 long_pause（1），无一条是 pure_filler 语气词。短 cut 的触发条件是 词/字级贴身重复 或 空档，不是孤立 filler token
self_correction 类样本极稀（2/59），但均值 5175ms、远高于 immediate_rep（477ms）与 long_pause（497ms）；Mentor 对自纠正做整段清理而非局部修补
两集 59 条中 pure_filler=0、rhetorical_emphasis=0。Mentor 既不孤立砍语气词（呃/嗯/那个/这个/就是），也不砍 说白了/讲真/其实/真的 类修辞强调——这是一条明确的负样本约束
long_pause 类的 mentor_crossfade_ms 均值 197.5ms，是 semantic_boundary/immediate_rep/self_correction（均 50ms）的近 4 倍；纯静默区间 Mentor 会显著加长过渡淡化
cut_lands_in_silence_gap 命中率：semantic_boundary 57%（24/42）、immediate_rep 仅 8%（1/12）、long_pause 1/3。语义边界剪辑对齐静默；重复剪辑往往落在活跃语音中——切位策略随类别而变

candidate_pattern.name: filler_boundary_lock_v2
candidate_pattern.condition: 候选 cut.duration_ms < 400 时，必须存在字符/词级贴身重复(has_char_repetition) 或 total_covered_words==0（纯静默）；仅命中孤立 filler token（呃/嗯/那个/这个/就是）不足以触发
candidate_pattern.observed_support: 6/6 短 cut 全部满足此条件（5 immediate_rep + 1 long_pause），无 pure_filler 反例

rule_proposals.note: 与用户 memory 中 'filler_boundary_lock' 一致，本 lens 提供 59 例的定量支撑；短 cut 不应因单一 filler token 触发

candidate_pattern.name: semantic_boundary_primary_target
candidate_pattern.condition: 当候选 cut 覆盖 >=600ms 有实文本 且 cut_lands_in_silence_gap==True 或 静默间隙相邻，优先接受为 semantic_boundary 类剪
candidate_pattern.observed_support: semantic_boundary 42/59 主体，均值 2720ms，57% 落在静默间隙

rule_proposals.note: 这是 Mentor 的主战场，模型应以 '找边界' 为核心目标，'剪 filler' 为辅

candidate_pattern.name: do_not_cut_rhetorical_or_isolated_filler
candidate_pattern.condition: 若 gold_deleted_text 仅由 filler token 或修辞强调词（说白了/讲真/坦白说/其实/真的）构成，且无重复/无自纠正上下文——拒绝剪辑

rule_proposals.note: 负样本极强；缺席即约束。默认策略里 '剪光所有语气词' 的直觉与 Mentor 行为相反

candidate_pattern.name: self_correction_all_or_nothing
candidate_pattern.condition: 识别到自纠正标记（不是/不对/应该说/或者说/我意思）或双轨语义大幅漂移(overlap<3 chars) 且 duration>=4000ms 时，整段清除而非局部
candidate_pattern.observed_support: self_correction 均值 5175ms，与 memory 中 'self_correction 全或无' 吻合

rule_proposals.note: 样本量小（n=2），中等置信；与用户既有规则 self_correction 全或无 直接互证

candidate_pattern.name: crossfade_by_category
candidate_pattern.condition: long_pause 类 crossfade = 200ms；其余类 crossfade = 50ms
candidate_pattern.observed_support: long_pause mean_xfade=197.5ms vs 其他三类均 50.0ms

rule_proposals.note: 数据一致性高但样本仅 3 条 long_pause，建议在更多集数上复核后固化

candidate_pattern.name: immediate_rep_active_speech_ok
candidate_pattern.condition: immediate_rep 类允许在非静默区剪（lands_in_silence 命中率仅 8%），只要贴身重复清晰即可执行，无需强制对齐静默
candidate_pattern.observed_support: 12/12 immediate_rep 均 cross_track_speaking=True，且 11/12 未落在静默间隙

rule_proposals.note: 打破 'cut 必须落在静默' 的过强前提；重复类允许 in-speech cut，Mentor 用 50ms xfade 抹平

top_findings: Mentor 剪的是 semantic boundary 与 immediate repetition，不是孤立 filler：LENS5 显示 semantic_boundary 71.2% + immediate_rep 20.3%，pure_filler=0 / rhetorical_emphasis=0；LENS1 boundary_review 65% 命中 silence gap 且 offset 中位 300ms（14/27 顶到 300ms 上限）；LENS4 半数（29/58）中段 RMS 明显高于两边（hump），说明剪掉的是有声内容的语义整段，而非静默里的语气词。三个 lens 互相印证 '找边界' 是主战场、'砍 filler' 是次要辅助。

mentor_crossfade_ms 不是局部特征函数，而是按 episode/类别 constant：LENS3 EP03 56/56=50ms，EP04 3/3≈200ms（其中 192.583ms 是 385ms 短 cut 的 window-clamp 量化产物）；LENS4 |RMS diff|<=3dB / 3-10 / >10 三桶中位数全部 50ms，最大 33.9dB mismatch 也不加长 fade；LENS5 只有 long_pause 类均值 197.5ms，其余三类严格 50ms。跨 lens 一致否定 duration/gold_category(局部)/silence_gap/cross_track/RMS-diff 作为 xfade 调制器。

cross_track_speaking 目前的定义已失效：LENS2 EP03 56/56=True 且两轨 covered_words 全非空、EP04 C034/C044 同文本 '就是我们*'/'因为' 完全是同一嘉宾双麦 bleed；LENS3 因该 flag 恒真而无法作为 xfade 调制信号。需按 (speaker_map[a]!=speaker_map[b]) AND (normalized(text_a)!=normalized(text_b)) 重新定义，否则 host+guest 真重叠信号被彻底掩盖。

下刀点分布高度结构化：mid-pause + 深植静音 + 尾长头短：LENS1 gap_before p25=120 / median=180 / p75=260ms，gap_after p25=120 / median=280 / p75=440ms（尾长 28 / 头长 20 / 对称 10），命中 silence gap 时 boundary_offset 中位 300ms 且 14/27 顶到 300ms 上限；LENS2 EP04 3/3 需 host 静默且 host gap_before≥1901ms / gap_after≥2604ms；紧贴词界（gb<50ms 且不在 silence gap）仅 3/58 且全属 pause 类。

边界 RMS 不匹配是被容忍的副产物，不是判定信号：LENS4 |before-after| >10dB 占 48%、>25dB 占 14%、极值 33.9dB；三种 regime（silence-silence 19% / asymmetric-silence 38% 最大 / speech-speech 28%）都出现在 gold 中；LENS3 crossfade 不为 RMS mismatch 加长；LENS5 immediate_rep 类 11/12 落在活跃语音中。要求 'silence-silence 边界' 会拒绝多数 mentor-approved 剪辑。

rule_proposals_merged.note: 融合 LENS3 P1/P6 + LENS5 SEM_P5 + LENS4 HOW-RMS-03。50ms 是稳定基线，仅 long_pause / EP04 三轨 profile 用 200ms；短 cut 需 window clamp。禁止基于 RMS/duration/silence/cross_track 自动缩放 xfade。样本量前提：EP04 仅 3 例，需更多集验证。
LENS5 SEM_P1 主体类（42/59=71.2%，中位 2020ms）+ LENS1 P1/P2/P3/P4（p25-p75 gap 主区间，boundary_review 65% 命中 silence，深植中段，尾长头短）。核心目标：'找边界' 而非 '砍 filler'。

candidate_pattern.reject_if: only_isolated_filler_token(呃/嗯/那个/这个/就是) without repetition or silence context

rule_proposals_merged.note: LENS5 SEM_P2（6/6 短 cut = 5 immediate_rep + 1 long_pause，pure_filler=0）+ 用户 memory filler_boundary_lock 直接互证。短 cut 不允许因单一 filler token 触发。

reject_if_all: gold_deleted_text ∈ {呃/嗯/啊/那个/这个/就是/说白了/讲真/坦白说/其实/真的}

rule_proposals_merged.note: LENS5 SEM_P4 强负样本（59/59 缺席）。'剪光所有语气词' 与 Mentor 行为完全相反，是硬约束。

trigger: self-correction marker in {不是/不对/应该说/或者说/我意思} OR dual-track semantic drift with overlap<3 chars

rule_proposals_merged.note: LENS5 SEM_P3 均值 5175ms（n=2）+ 用户 memory self_correction 全或无。样本量偏小，medium confidence。

candidate_pattern.cut_edge_style: 词尾/次词首贴紧（gb≈100ms / ga≈120ms 中位）

rule_proposals_merged.note: LENS5 SEM_P6（immediate_rep 11/12 未落静默）+ LENS1 pause 分类 13/13 lands=False。打破 '刀必落静默' 前提。
LENS1 P1+P3+P4 + candidate_gate_gap_window + candidate_reject_glued_to_word + candidate_prefer_tail_heavier 合并。深植静音中段而非蹭边缘；尾长头短是主流。

candidate_pattern.action_hard: flag for review OR relocate cut point (do NOT extend xfade)

rule_proposals_merged.note: LENS4 HOW-RMS-01/02/03/04/05 合并。48% gold >10dB，14% >25dB；asymmetric-silence 38% 最大。要求 silence-silence 会拒绝多数 mentor cut。中段 louder 是正常语义剪辑签名。
LENS2 P1+P2+P3 + LENS3 P5 合并。当前 cross_track_speaking 100% True 是同人双麦 bleed 伪信号；重定义后可释放真 overlap 信号。EP04 n=3 太小，host 保护规则作为 soft prior。

system_gaps: generate_comprehensive_cut.py 若按 'silence-silence 边界 + 短 filler token 直接砍' 直觉出候选，会与 Mentor 行为直接对立：LENS5 pure_filler=0 / rhetorical=0，LENS4 asymmetric-silence 38% 是最大 regime，semantic_boundary 71.2% 覆盖 600ms+ 语义整段——需要新增 'semantic_boundary_primary_target' 通道与 filler 负样本硬约束。
缺少按语义类别 route 的 crossfade 策略：现脚本大概率单一默认 xfade。需要按 profile+class 双层查表（EP03=50 / EP04=200 / long_pause 类覆写 200 / 其他 50）并在短 cut 上做 window clamp（min(target, dur - 128 samples)）。

cross_track_speaking 判定错误：当前 flag 只看 '两轨都有文本'，把同人双麦 bleed 与真 host+guest overlap 混为一谈（EP03 100% true, EP04 C034/C044 同文本 bleed）。需引入 speaker_map + normalized(text) 差异判定，否则 host-silent gate、solo-guest router 都无法建立。
缺少 host-silent gate / host-protect：EP04 3/3 gold 需 host.covered_word_texts=='' 且 host gap>=1.5s；脚本若允许 main_track==host 会产生非 gold 候选。soft veto 需要 host_track_id 与 speaker_map 元数据支持。
缺少 boundary-offset 精细 zone：当前脚本可能仅 '找 silence gap 中心'，但 gold 中位深植 300ms、14/27 顶到 300ms 上限、p25=76ms 是软下限；同时需要 gb<50ms 且不在 silence 的硬拒绝分支与 tail-heavier tie-breaker（ga>=0.9*gb）。
缺少 immediate_rep in-speech 通道：当前脚本若强制 'cut 必须落在 silence gap'，会拒掉 11/12 mentor immediate_rep 短 cut。需要独立 in-speech 剪路径 + 50ms xfade 抹平。
缺少 self_correction 全或无判定：需要自纠正 marker 词表 + 双轨语义漂移（overlap<3 chars）检测 + duration>=4000ms 联合触发，且必须整段清除而非局部。
缺少 boundary RMS 阈值配置：soft 15dB / hard 25dB；middle-hump 只在 rms_middle-max(edges)>10dB 且不在 silence 时才报警——脚本若使用 '中段更响=可疑' 的默认启发式会误报 50% gold。
缺少 episode profile 概念：xfade 是 per-episode/production constant 而非 per-cut。脚本需读取 profile.json 或从近邻已批准剧集回填 xfade 默认，不要基于本地音频特征回归。
分类启发式不足：LENS5 semantic_boundary 是兜底类，可能混入本可拆分的 immediate_rep/self_correction；脚本内部分类器需与 raw gold_category（boundary_review/pause/filler_hesitation）+ 字符重复检测 + self_correction marker 三路并行，避免误归。
next_challenger_tasks: 拉取 >=3 集额外 gold 数据（尤其含 intra-episode xfade 变化的集），验证 xfade 是 per-episode constant 还是 per-project constant——目前 EP03/EP04 各自恒定，无法区分。
构造 cross_track_speaking=false 的样本切片（单轨或明确单人段），验证重定义后的 flag 是否恢复信号；并检测重定义后 EP04 C034/C044 是否翻转为 False。
扩大 self_correction 样本至 n>=10（当前仅 2 例 GOLD_C027/C044+EP04_C034），验证 '全或无 & duration>=4000ms' 规则；引入自纠正 marker 词表在 EP01/EP02 反向标注。
在 EP04 之外寻找 host+guest 真重叠（非双麦 bleed）的 gold cut，确认 host-silent gate 是硬规则还是 soft prior，并测量 host 允许的最小 gap 阈值。
跑一次 challenger：用当前 generate_comprehensive_cut.py 生成候选 vs Mentor gold 做混淆矩阵，特别检查 pure_filler/rhetorical 假阳率与 semantic_boundary 假阴率，量化 '砍 filler 直觉' 造成的偏移。
对 42 条 semantic_boundary 做二次拆分：用主题分割 / 说话人转换 / 时间戳文本相似度回归，判断兜底类内部是否隐藏可拆分的 immediate_rep/self_correction，反查 lens5 分类器的 recall 上限。
在紧贴词界 gb<50ms 的 3 条样本（GOLD_C008/C021/C029）做逐一听审，确认硬拒绝规则是否会误伤真实的 pause-edge 场景。
为 boundary_offset 300ms 顶格（14/27）做因果分析：是 Mentor 主观深植还是工具默认 padding？读取工程文件里的 nudge/offset 参数验证。
验证 EP04 三条 200ms xfade 是否与 '三轨多人过渡' 强绑定，还是仅与 long_pause 类相关；构造只有 long_pause 但双轨的样本切片测试。
为 RMS 15dB soft / 25dB hard 阈值做 ROC 分析：在非 gold 候选（generate_comprehensive_cut.py 产出的 rejected 候选）上跑，看阈值是否能区分 gold vs non-gold，或是完全独立于 gold 判定。
